sloka: अस्मिन्नेवाभिसम्प्राप्तं लोके विदितमस्तु ते ।विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रः स रावणः ।दौरात्म्येनात्मनोद्धूतस्तप्ताम्भ इव सागरः ।। ७.२५.२९ ॥
transliteration: asminnevābhisamprāptaṁ loke viditamastu te ।vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasendraḥ sa rāvaṇaḥ ।daurātmyenātmanoddhūtastaptāmbha iva sāgaraḥ ।। 7.25.29 ॥

translations.english: Let it be known to you that upon hearing Vibhishana's words, that king of demons Ravana was agitated by his own wickedness, like an ocean stirred by hot water.
